subject.title: Daylog: automatic work journal plugin with Control UI timeline tab

question: Should Logbook land in OpenClaw as a bundled disabled-by-default plugin with a Control UI surface, or should this screen-capture workflow stay external until the privacy and plugin-API policy is settled?
rationale: The request adds a new plugin, screen-capture pipeline, local retention model, model-analysis path, gateway methods, and Control UI surface; code inspection cannot decide that product/security boundary.

options.title: Review linked implementation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99930 as the candidate implementation and require its security, compatibility, privacy, and merge-conflict blockers to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Redirect external first
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub or external plugin package until maintainers confirm that bundling and a core Control UI tab are product priorities.

options.title: Decline bundled capture
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide automatic work-journal screen capture does not fit OpenClaw's bundled plugin policy.

recommendation.title: Review linked implementation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99930 as the candidate implementation and require its security, compatibility, privacy, and merge-conflict blockers to be resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the proposal and linked implementation context, though final acceptance still needs maintainer approval.
